purpose: Teach: 月別/予備校/破損/労災/ストレージ/辞職/役に立っ/明言

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 売上、月別の動向、毎月、私に、報告しろ。
lines.en: Sales figures. I want monthly trends reported to me every single month.
lines.style: Sharp, clipped delivery. Each phrase lands with weight. No filler. Expectation hanging in the air like a standing order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、予備校の学費支援、新人事制度として、検討中です。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're currently evaluating a new HR system that would include tuition assistance for cram school.
lines.style: Composed, measured cadence. Professional formality without stiffness. Voice stays level—this is routine competence being reported upward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 納品時の破損、調査、徹底させろ。
lines.en: Damage during delivery. I want a thorough investigation into every incident.
lines.style: Flat, authoritative. Each word placed deliberately. No room for interpretation. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労災申請の手続き、社員にも、丁寧に、説明しております。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're explaining the workers' compensation procedures to staff carefully and thoroughly.
lines.style: Steady reassurance. Slightly slower pace—communicating that care and clarity are being taken seriously. Voice gentle but substantive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社内データのストレージ、容量、見直す時期だ。
lines.en: We need to review our internal data storage capacity. That time is coming soon.
lines.style: Decisive but not harsh. A statement of fact delivered with quiet certainty. The tone of someone thinking ahead about practical problems.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。部長の辞職、後任、慎重に、選んでまいります。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll be selecting the department head's replacement very carefully.
lines.style: Respectful, composed. Slight emphasis on 'carefully'—acknowledging the weight of the decision. Voice carries both assurance and appropriate gravity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この提案、本当に、役に立った経験、報告書に、書け。
lines.en: Document the real outcomes of this proposal. I want to see what actually worked and how it made a difference.
lines.style: Direct command with underlying purpose. Lean forward slightly in the tone. Wants specifics, not vagueness. Results-oriented and clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営方針、社員に、明言する場、来週、設けます。
lines.en: Yes, sir. Next week we'll hold a meeting where management can clearly state our policy direction to the whole staff.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation. Voice carries readiness—already thinking through logistics. Professional closure to the exchange, no lingering questions.
